
The following figures shows the uniform hazard spectra for spectral ordinates with 5% damping in rock (BC) for different confidence levels.

```{r echo=FALSE}
Vs30_TARGET <- 220
TR_TARGET <- c(100,200,500,1000,2000,2500,5000,10000)
UHS <- UHSTable[Vref==760 & Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & SM=="gmdp" & ID=="nrc_v3.19.1" & TR %in% TR_TARGET]

```


::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}



:::


::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills .content-visible when-format="html" unless-format="revealjs"}


### p=50%

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- 0.50
#| fig-cap: "Uniform Hazard Spectra (UHS) for %s (p=%s) assuming site conditions with Vs30=%4d m/s." |> sprintf("Sa(Tn)",p_TARGET,Vs30_TARGET)
#| label: fig-UHS.50.site.html
#| column: page-inset-right

DATA <- UHS[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p == p_TARGET,.(ID=TR,Y=Sa,X=Tn)][order(X)]|> unique()
YMAX <- max(1.2*DATA$Y,na.rm=TRUE) |> round(1)
setorder(DATA,X)
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="spline",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.max = YMAX,
  xAxis.legend="Tn [s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa [g]",
  group.legend="TR [yr]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```
